questions.q: Paralegal A discovers definitive proof that Paralegal B (who works at a different firm) is systematically embezzling funds from their mixed trust account. What is Paralegal A's mandatory obligation under the Rules of Conduct?
options: Blackmail Paralegal B to stop or else they will report them.
Notify the local police department first.
Report Paralegal B's financial misconduct to the Law Society of Ontario (LSO).
Keep the information confidential as a matter of professional courtesy.
questions.explain: Rule 9.01 outlines the duty to report to the Law Society. A paralegal must report to the LSO another licensee's serious financial misconduct, misappropriation of trust monies, or other situations raising a substantial question as to the licensee's honesty, trustworthiness, or competency.
